experiences.name: Sagrada Família Guided Tour
experiences.description: Explore Gaudí's iconic unfinished basilica with a guided tour that reveals the intricate symbolism, stunning stained glass, and architectural genius behind one of the world's most unique buildings. Book a tower access ticket for panoramic city views.

experiences.name: Palau de la Música Catalana Evening Concert
experiences.description: Attend a live concert at this UNESCO World Heritage modernista masterpiece designed by Lluís Domènech i Montaner. The stunning stained glass ceiling and ornate interior make this a breathtaking fusion of architecture and nightlife culture.

experiences.name: Gothic Quarter & El Born Architecture Walk
experiences.description: Self-guided or small-group walking tour through Barcelona's medieval Gothic Quarter and trendy El Born neighborhood, discovering Roman ruins, Gothic cathedrals, and modernista gems. Finish with tapas and craft cocktails at a local bar.

experiences.name: Poble Sec & Montjuïc Nightlife Circuit
experiences.description: Experience Barcelona's vibrant nightlife scene starting with dinner at a pintxos bar in Poble Sec, then head to Sala Apolo or Mau Mau for live music and DJ sets. Poble Sec is conveniently close to Sant Just Desvern and offers an authentic local atmosphere.

experiences.name: Pavillon Mies van der Rohe & Montjuïc Architecture Trail
experiences.description: Visit the iconic Barcelona Pavilion, a landmark of modern architecture designed for the 1929 World Exhibition, then explore the surrounding Montjuïc hill featuring the MNAC museum, Olympic Stadium, and stunning city panoramas. A perfect half-day architectural journey just minutes from Sant Just Desvern.
